verdicts_or_reports.expected: Changing the preparation form to Injection should leave the subtype unset until I explicitly choose Ampule or Vial.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Ampule is already selected as soon as Injection is selected, before I pick a subtype.
steps: Open Plan > Medicines > Add medicine.
With the default Estradiol category, tap Tablet, then tap Injection.
Observe the Preparation type options without tapping Ampule or Vial.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The medicine card should preserve the entered capsule strength of 0.125 mg, or display enough precision to avoid changing it.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The editor retains 0.125 mg, but the Medicines list rounds the card to 0.13 mg.
steps: Open Plan > Medicines > Add medicine.
Choose Custom, keep Tablet, enter the name QA Custom and strength 0.125 mg.
Save the medicine, return to the Medicines list, and compare the card with Edit medicine, where the strength remains 0.125.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The card should display the saved strength 0.125 mg, or enough precision to preserve the entered value.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Edit medicine retains 0.125 mg, while the list card rounds it to 0.13 mg.
steps: Open Plan > Medicines > Add medicine.
Choose Custom, select Capsule, enter the name QA Custom and capsule strength 0.125 mg.
Save the medicine and return to the Medicines list.
Open QA Custom > Edit medicine to confirm the field still contains 0.125 mg, then return to the list.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Last visible medicine card at bottom of the list
verdicts_or_reports.field: List scrolling and access to lower entries
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After rotation, the Medicines list should scroll or reflow so cards below the viewport and Add medicine remain reachable.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The list remains fixed at the top after repeated upward swipes; the last visible card is clipped at the bottom, and later entries and Add medicine cannot be reached.
steps: Starting from a fresh install, add enough medicines to exceed five list rows across categories (for example Estradiol tablet, injection, gel and patch, plus Antiandrogen and SERM medicines).
Open Plan > Medicines in portrait and confirm the lower entries are present.
Rotate to landscape.
Swipe up over the list several times; the visible rows do not move and entries below the clipped patch row, including Add medicine, stay unreachable.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The list should scroll in landscape or arrange the remaining medicine rows and Add medicine within the visible area.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The list does not move when swiped upward; the visible Remove patch row is clipped at the bottom and all following cards and Add medicine remain off-screen.
steps: On a fresh install, open Plan > Medicines and add an Estradiol Tablet with strength 1 mg.
Add an Estradiol Injection, choose Vial, set concentration 20 mg/mL and vial volume 5 mL.
Add an Estradiol Gel Container at 0.06% and 80 g.
Add an Estradiol Patch with Release rate 50 μg/day.
Add a second Estradiol Gel as Sachet at 0.1% and 1 g.
Add an Antiandrogen Tablet (Spironolactone 50 mg) and a SERM Tablet (Raloxifene 60 mg).
Return to Medicines, rotate to landscape, then swipe upward over the visible cards repeatedly. The list remains at the top and the remaining rows and Add medicine are unreachable.
